about nexai

Built as a hybrid company from the first commit.

NexAI started with one question: why does a software team need a lease? We put together engineers, a designer, and a QA lead across four countries and went looking for the first client instead of an office.

how we work

Async by default

Meetings are the exception, not the schedule. Decisions live in writing so the next timezone can pick them up.

Fixed scope, fixed price

We quote the outcome, not the hours. Estimates are our risk to manage, not yours.

Your infrastructure

Code lands in your repo, on your cloud account, from day one. Nothing to migrate later.

Senior by design

Every engineer on a project has shipped production software before — we don't train on your budget.
